blocks.text:
As your plane glides toward Rio de Janeiro, the Marvellous City reveals itself like a vibrant painting — emerald hills rolling toward the turquoise sea, golden beaches stretching endlessly, and the glitter of an urban skyline where history and modernity meet. It’s a city where every corner hums with music, color, and the freedom to simply be.

Your private driver will greet you at the airport and guide you through the city’s first embrace — passing colonial façades, palm-lined avenues, and the legendary beaches that have long been stages for joy, diversity, and unforgettable encounters.

The air is warm, the light golden, and the rhythm of the city seems to sync with your heartbeat. A walk along Copacabana’s mosaic promenade tells its own story: a cold caipirinha in hand, the sound of laughter mixing with the ocean breeze, friends gathering for impromptu dances, and a kaleidoscope of beachgoers, each adding their own hue to the canvas of Rio.

Here, authenticity isn’t just welcomed — it’s celebrated. Every sunset feels like an invitation, every smile a reminder that you’ve arrived somewhere you can truly shine. Soon, you’ll be at your hotel, ready to let Rio’s magic unfold.

blocks.text: Rio de Janeiro: Corcovado and nightlife

After a delicious tropical breakfast in your hotel, you will head out on a trip to see the world-famous Christ the Saviour statue on top of Corcovado Mountain. A specially designed train will take you from the foot of the mountain along a winding road through the magical Tijuca rainforest, where you will spot some of Rio’s enchanting tropical wildlife, such as toucans, monkeys, and armadillos. At the summit of Corcovado, 700m above sea level, proudly stands the iconic image recognized around the world – a 38m high statue of Christ the Saviour. But that is not the only breathtaking thing about this place – standing so close to the statue, you will be overwhelmed by the stunning panoramic view of the city, so high it feels as if you are truly flying alongside the birds. From the far reaches of Guanabara Bay to the Maracanã Stadium, and from Sugarloaf Mountain to Copacabana, Ipanema and Gávea Mountain, you can see the whole of Rio de Janeiro.

After returning to your hotel for a brief rest, your evening adventure begins. Your private driver will pick you up and take you to one of Rio’s most vibrant LGBTQIA+ bars, where music, colors, and smiles fill the air. Known for its diverse and welcoming nightlife, Rio de Janeiro offers countless places for the LGBTQIA+ community and its friends to enjoy themselves — from intimate cocktail lounges to lively dance clubs that keep the energy going until dawn. Whether you’re looking to meet locals, dance to Brazilian beats, or simply enjoy a caipirinha while soaking in the atmosphere, the city’s inclusive spirit will make your night unforgettable.

At the end of the night, your driver will take you safely back to your hotel.
